headline: Nevish Line and Linn Mercy See Continued Heavy Exchanges
war_summary: Since the evening edition the Nevish Line has advanced from 59 to 63 transfers in the day, with five in the last two hours centring on Grief Mother, Unruly and the Scrying Belt, now showing seven Colonial posts and one ruin on reported 24-hour losses of 11,157 Colonial and 14,241 Warden. Linn Mercy has moved from 40 to 42, with five in two hours about Outwich Ranch, Rotdust and Lathair, holding ten Colonial posts and one ruin on 7,086 Colonial and 8,956 Warden losses. Callahan's Passage has gone quiet with none in two hours, though the day total stands at 19 all at Crumbling Post and now lists ten Warden posts. Mooring County reports two in six hours, 16 on the day about the Wind Hills, with ten Warden and two Colonial posts. The Weathered Expanse and Marban Hollow report nothing in six hours, holding seven Warden posts and two ruins and four Warden, three Colonial and one ruin respectively, while Briar in Stlican Shelf shows three with no movement in six hours.
